{{armor art infobox | campaign = [[Eye of the North]] | pvp = Tinted Spectacles | pvpreward = Basic | specialgallery = Tinted Spectacles }} '''Tinted Spectacles''' is a prestige headgear art available in the Eye of the North expansion.
